name: Bonjin ~ An Ordinary Man
source: When your beloved wants to abandon his personality and become an absolutely ordinary person, what do you do? Bonjin ~ An Ordinary Man is an intimate young adult story about transgender identity, exploration of masculinity, and mutual understanding.
translation: 当你的爱人想要放弃自己的个性，成为一个绝对的普通人时，你会怎么做？《Bonjin ~ 一个普通男人》是一个关于跨性别身份、探索男性气质和相互理解的亲密年轻人故事。
